sunoData.title: Tideward Passage
sunoData.tags: Ambient game soundtrack, slow floating pulse with soft oceanic percussion and long evolving pads; verse-like sections drift on sparse marimba droplets and brushed hand drums, pre-drop thickens with filtered swell and distant glassy chords, main section opens into wider harmonic bed with gentle arpeggios and sub-bass tide movement. Ear candy includes reversed wave swells, cavernous chimes, and occasional bubble clicks between phrases. Mix is wide, airy, and polished, intimate in the low mids with luminous top-end shimmer., ambient
